title: Variant list
description: Derived from design/EVALUATION_INTERFACES.md 1.2 (Draft); the document wins. Draft: ARIADNE specifies this format and Tillman Heisner freezes its version (section 1.3; D9 A). The variant list (section 3.2): one row per entry variant, with opaque ids and file names; none of its fields enters a packet (section 6, rule 6). Measurement-only size variants are flagged with measurement_only true.
$comment: Derived from design/EVALUATION_INTERFACES.md 1.2 (Draft); the document wins. Section 3.2 gives the row fields; the list-level fields follow section 3 (List-level fields); rows, the key that holds the rows, is proposed. Checksums are lowercase (section 3). Record variants are frozen files of an item (section 3.4) and are not listed here; their parent record is recorded on the expected side only. Not expressed here: that ids and file names say nothing about what is tested (section 6, rule 5); that split is the parent's split; that checksums match the files. The examples are illustrative: ids, times, checksums, sizes, counts and names are made up, except the SHA-256 of the parent file T9HQ4X, which is the real value of the stored file (8,137 bytes).

evaluation_interfaces_version.description: The version of design/EVALUATION_INTERFACES.md the list follows (section 3, List-level fields).

frozen_on.description: The date Tillman Heisner froze it; absent while it is a draft (section 3).

variant_id.description: Opaque id, for example V-0007; never descriptive.

parent_id.description: The entry or variant it was made from.

variant_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the variant file, computed by software.

measurement_only.description: true for a measurement-only size variant, which belongs to the development set.

checksum.description: A checksum: the SHA-256 of a file's exact bytes as stored, 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters, computed by software (Run records 1.2 and 2.9; Evaluation interfaces, section 3).
